name: Guarded HTTP Request
description: Reusable sub-workflow that wraps any HTTP request with governance guards. Pattern: GuardGate evaluates the request payload, blocks if risk tier exceeds threshold, executes the HTTP request on pass, then seals the request/response as evidence. Call this instead of raw HTTP Request nodes to ensure every external call is governed.

nodes.name: Sub-Workflow Trigger
nodes.notes: Expects input: { url, method, headers, body, rubricPack, blockTier, policyRef, approverId }

parameters.metadata: ={{ JSON.stringify({ url: $json._request.url, method: $json._request.method, status: $json._response.statusCode, risk_tier: $json._guard.risk_tier, workflow: 'guarded-http-request' }) }}
